body:
Hello @millansingh,

* For now you will have to run the three instances at once and write custom logic to handle the one displayed on your own.
* In the near future you will be able to dispose and re-initialize an instance (cf https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/issues/2407#issuecomment-332852801) but I don't have any ETA for this feature release.
